description.html: This plastic dish has a simple kidney shape with rounded edges and a completely smooth inside. The light blue color is not meant to imitate natural stone but to be practical: against a light background you can see right away when the water is cloudy or has substrate and droppings in it.

That is why dishes like this are popular with breeders and in terrariums where hygiene comes first, for example quarantine for a new animal, hatchlings or an animal that is recovering. Smooth plastic has no pores where bacteria could linger, so it can be washed in seconds.
The dish is suitable for both water and food, such as insects, worms or chopped vegetables.

A plastic dish is lighter than stone ones, so place it on a level surface or press it slightly into the substrate so larger, stronger animals do not move it. Do not put it directly under a heat lamp or on a heat mat. Change the water every day, wash the dish with warm water and rinse it well.
